desc.zh: 逐格排除冲突，用已用数集合保持约束，失败后完整撤销。
desc.en: Exclude conflicts cell by cell, cache used digits, and restore each failed choice.

complexity: O(9^E) time; O(E) auxiliary space for E empty cells on the fixed 9×9 board

concepts.name: Sudoku backtracking and restoration
concepts.description: Cache used digits and restore the board and all three constraint sets after failure.

concepts.name: Local validity versus completion
concepts.description: Hand-calculate a legal move that leaves the next cell without a candidate.
